entry.title: New: RES26-020 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF TRAVEL, HOTEL ACCOMMODATIONS, MEALS, AND RELATED EXPENSES, VALUED AT $5,874, TO THE CITY FROM THE AMERICAN ASSOCIATION OF MOTOR VEHICLE ADMINISTRATORS FOR REPRESENTATIVES FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF CUSTOMER SERVICES AND THE DEPARTMENT OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY TO ATTEND AN IN-PERSON SITE VISIT TO THE ARIZONA DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES FROM APRIL 20–23, 2026.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution as amended were adopted.
